$comment: Machine-readable subject-to-file map for `compliance_report.py inventory` (step 01). subject-file-map.md is the human description of the same rules; keep the two in sync. Glob rules: matched against the target-relative path with '/' separators, case-sensitive; '**' spans any number of folders, '*' and '?' stay inside one name, '{a,b}' lists alternatives; a pattern with no '/' matches the file name in any folder; a leading '/' anchors it to the target root. 'contains' is a regular expression searched in the file text (a value starting with '@' names an entry in 'patterns'). Each subject's tiers are in sampling priority order: when more than maxFilesPerSubject files match, the sample takes up to 'max' files from each tier in order ('perDir' spreads them across folders), then fills from the remaining matches. Tests: tiers exclude test files unless 'tests' is 'include' or 'only'.
